execution.network_lane: local hermetic browser origin; no artificial delay or loss
execution.measure_clock: shared harness monotonic timeline; browser clock calibration required for paint

payload.generator: byte[i] = 32 + ((seed + source_index*17 + event_index*31 + i*13) % 95), indexes zero based; then overwrite prefix/suffix as declared
payload.encoding: raw bytes, not a shell command

growth.prefill_commit_schedule: all prior appends, one sync and commit covering the last record
growth.allocation_measurement_scope: one isolated package run, no parallel tests; report process noise separately

schedule.constant_rate_lanes: event time = event_index*(1000000000/events_per_second_per_source) + source_index*source_phase_ns; emit while time < lane duration; default duration is execution.quick_duration_ns
schedule.piecewise_lanes: segments are authoritative when present; within each segment, event time = start_ns + segment_event_index*(1000000000/events_per_second_per_source) + source_index*source_phase_ns; emit only start_ns <= event time < end_ns
schedule.segment_event_index: starts at zero separately for each source in each segment; phase is relative to that segment start
schedule.boundary_rule: start inclusive, end exclusive; a source-zero event exactly at 1000000000 ns belongs only to the second burst segment
schedule.payload_event_index: continuous zero-based count per source across all emitted segments; bounded_burst first second-segment payload index is 400
schedule.bounded_burst_duration: segments fix this quick calibration lane at 60000000000 ns; longer qualification repetitions repeat the entire lane with a fresh lane origin and payload indexes

candidate_budget.status: targets to reconcile with measured ownership; not enforced by this workload
candidate_budget.cleanup_reserve: separate accounting before ordinary acceptance; numerical command/envelope reserve must preserve existing funded generation/fault/close paths

acceptance.latency_status: proposed goals; must calibrate full decode-to-paint clock and include all failures/timeouts/max lag
acceptance.overload: bounded acceptance, explicit continuity break, valid committed content retained, source unchanged, eventual exactly-once settlement after held work is released
acceptance.stalled_work: independent diagnostics remain readable; no deadline-implies-cleanup or late successful readiness
